subject_group: 9.2.1 Crew station and control station layout

versions.text:
Standard: The transparency system shape does not interfere with crewmember motions while wearing required crewmember equipment during normal and emergency conditions. Crewmember motions consider any movement in which crewmembers might come into contact with the transparency (e.g., normal ingress and egress, emergency egress, check-six, landing, use of specialized cockpit equipment, transferring equipment from one crew member to another, inertial reactions to accelerations, AR) as required by the air vehicle’s operations. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to identify any potential interference with crewmember positions and motions while wearing required crewmember equipment during normal and emergency conditions. Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in a representative mockup or on the air vehicle that participants representative of the intended anthropometric range can accomplish normal and emergency procedures while wearing required crewmember equipment. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) Demonstrate during flight test that transparency system shape does not interfere with crewmember positions and motions while wearing required crewmember equipment during representative operating conditions.
